name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🚪 Club meetings: officers check people in by typing 2 letters of a name and tapping it. Each person counts once, however they're checked in.
📝 A blank paper sign-in sheet (numbered lines, Member or Visitor), and a quick way to type it in after the meeting.
🔳 Each meeting has its own code, made by the club's server: show it on your phone or print it ahead. It works only on the meeting's day.
✅ Members check in by scanning the meeting code with Wingman's own camera. No service? Sign the paper sheet; nothing waits on the phone.
👤 Members with no email can be on the club's list and checked in. A club's admin can merge two rows for the same person.
⬆️ If your copy of the app is too old for clubs, My club says so, with the download link.
🏷️ Two members with the same name? A club's admin can give one a short label, like Hope Mills, shown next to the name.
🧪 What testers should know: tap 🧪 Testing on Home. Founding clubs' members get everything free while they're members in good standing; the free features stay free for everyone.
